text:
morgan_support: reporting multiple customers hitting intermittent SSL errors running our async sample on Windows venvs behind corporate proxies. Error: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED.
morgan_support: repro: python -m venv .venv; .venv\Scripts\activate; pip install -r samples/requirements.txt; set HTTPS_PROXY=...; python samples\async_echo.py
lee_py: do you see the error only on Windows? Which Python builds (3.8/3.9/3.11)?
morgan_support: seen on 3.9.12 and 3.11.4. Works on mac/linux. Stack: ssl.SSLCertVerificationError -> httpx.ConnectError / Max retries exceeded.
tara_sdk: likely two things: (1) venv OpenSSL not wired to Windows cert store, (2) our retry hides original ssl error. Quick customer workaround: pip install certifi certifi-win32 and set SSL_CERT_FILE to certifi.where().
sam_security: note: certifi-win32 may conflict with org policy. Document both system-store and certifi approaches.
lee_py: SDK action items: (A) accept ca_bundle/verify param on AsyncClient and sync client, (B) honor SSL_CERT_FILE and REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE env vars early, (C) add clearer CertVerificationError that includes hint text.
tara_sdk: agree. Also expose httpx_client_options to let users set trust_env=False if they want to avoid proxy env behavior.
morgan_support: example minimal snippet we gave customers:
```python
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient
async def main():
    async with AsyncClient(api_key="x", ca_bundle="C:/path/to/ca.pem") as c:
        await c.chat.create("hi")
asyncio.run(main())
```
lee_py: typing note: we got CI failures on py3.8 because we used ParamSpec/Protocol without typing_extensions. Plan: add typing_extensions for py<3.10 in extras or install_requires.
sam_security: also add Private deployment doc: how to mount CA bundle, proxy allowlist for KMS, and firewall rules for certificate revocation checks.
tara_sdk: small implementation sketch: cafile = os.environ.get('SSL_CERT_FILE') or os.environ.get('REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE') or certifi.where(); ssl_ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile=cafile); pass to httpx transport. Also chain SSLError into CertVerificationError.
ci-bot: created ticket #4831: add ca_bundle param + honor env + typing_extensions.
morgan_support: for support reply I'll suggest certifi-win32 or setting SSL_CERT_FILE and recommend WSL as workaround when feasible. Thanks all.
